selectiveHotelling

Selective inference for the difference in means between two estimated clusters, when the covariance matrix of the features is unknown.

Clustering and then testing the clusters with a textbook two-sample test uses the data twice, and the test rejects true null hypotheses far too often. selectiveHotelling computes selective p-values that control the selective Type I error for any clustering algorithm (k-means, hierarchical clustering, community detection, …) without estimating the covariance matrix.

Installation 

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("yiqunchen/selectiveHotelling")

The package depends only on base R.

Quick start 

library(selectiveHotelling)

set.seed(1)
X <- rbind(matrix(rnorm(40), 20, 2),
           matrix(rnorm(40), 20, 2) + 5,
           matrix(rnorm(40), 20, 2) - 5)

res <- selective_hotelling_test(X, k1 = 1, k2 = 2, K = 3)   # k-means with K = 3
res$pval       # selective p-value for clusters 1 and 2
res$cluster    # the clusters that were tested

# hierarchical clustering
selective_hotelling_test(X, k1 = 1, k2 = 2, K = 3, clustering = "hclust")

# any clustering function that maps a data matrix to cluster labels
cl_fun <- function(x) cutree(hclust(dist(x), method = "complete"), k = 3)
selective_hotelling_bc(X, cl_fun, k1 = 1, k2 = 2)

The package website has tutorials for k-means, hierarchical clustering, arbitrary clustering algorithms, and the one-dimensional test, a real data example, and the technical details. Its source is in vignettes/articles/.

Main functions

Function Purpose
selective_hotelling_test() Selective test after k-means or hierarchical clustering
selective_hotelling_bc() Selective test after any clustering function
selective_truncated_F() One-dimensional selective test (faster, conditions on more)
hotelling_T2() Two-sample Hotelling statistic for a pair of clusters

Reference

Chen, Y. T. and Gao, L. L. Selective inference for clustering under unknown covariance. Code that reproduces the paper: https://github.com/yiqunchen/selectiveHotelling-paper.
